Hi Maria / BrightHealth procurement team,

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation on tradeoffs between per-seat HSM licensing, audit-log retention, and the residency uplift for EU/CA regions. Attached is our initial cost-split proposal for the add-on items we discussed. High level:

- Audit logs: tiered retention (30/90/365 days) as line items
- HSM: per-seat + a volume discount schedule for seats beyond 5
- Residency uplift: a regional surcharge to cover dedicated control plane and longer retention for copies

Two asks from us so we can finalize pricing:
1) Which retention tier do you need for the pilot (30/90/365)?
2) Is BrightHealth okay with a per-seat HSM model or do you prefer a usage-based KMS model?

I've copied Rishi and Priyom to provide the proposed math and alternate credit structures respectively. If you can reply with preferred retention and whether procurement needs a single line item for "Compliance Add-ons" or separate line items, we can get a clean PO-ready quote out by Friday.

Attachments: Audit_Log_Specs_v2.pdf (spec + sample events), Redwood-Compliance-MA-v1.docx (SOW + standard terms)

Kimberly — thanks, appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifying questions before we circulate to our security and procurement:

Maria / Team,

Attaching a simple pricing matrix (HSM-seat-pricing.xlsx) and a short TCO outline below to address the per-seat vs usage question. Summary first:

- For small fleets (<=5 HSM seats) per-seat is marginally more expensive but simpler to bill.
- For medium/large (>5 seats) we recommend per-seat with volume tiers: 1-5: $2,200/seat/mo, 6-20: $1,600/seat/mo, 21+: $1,100/seat/mo.
- Alternative KMS usage model: $0.0025 per KMS-API call + $0.12 per 10k EKM ops — this typically benefits very spiky workloads.

Audit logs: pricing here is storage + ingestion. Proposed line items:
- Base audit package (30 days) included with platform
- 90-day retention: +$0.03 per GB/month
- 365-day retention: +$0.07 per GB/month
- Option: flat retention fee for regulated customers: $9,500/mo for up to 10TB (we can scale linearly)

Residency uplift: one-time setup + monthly overhead. Proposed: one-time setup $18,000 per additional control plane region + $2,500/mo regional management overhead. We can absorb one-time setup if you commit to a 12-month reserved capacity add-on.

I'm attaching the matrix with worked examples for 12-month TCO for your 3 scenarios (pilot: 2 seats, expansion: 12 seats, enterprise: 30 seats). Let us know which scenario is closest to your plan and we will produce a clean quote and a PO-ready line itemization.

Best,
Rishi
Sr. Pricing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HSM-seat-pricing.xlsx

Quick note with an alternate packaging approach that often shortens procurement cycles:

Proposal A (line items): separate line items for audit retention, HSM seats, residency uplift (what Rishi outlined).
Proposal B (credit/allowance): bundle a Compliance Credit (annual) — e.g., $120k/year credit applied to audit storage and HSM OPEX. + a single invoice line for "Compliance Enablement" with a capped overage rate.

Pros/cons:
- Line items: transparent; easier for accounting to allocate, but more line items to negotiate.
- Credit: cleaner for procurement (one line), easier to offer concessions/credits during renewal, but requires definitions in SOW for credit application and an audit mechanism.

If BrightHealth needs SOC2/test reports immediately, CloudTrust (our HSM partner) can provide an attestation packet — I can introduce a contact if you want.

Attachment: Audit_Log_Specs_v2.pdf (event sampling + retention SLAs)

Happy to run either path — if procurement prefers a single invoice line we can sketch the credit language for legal.

— Priyom
Principal Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Maria — looping back with an actionable path forward based on your feedback:

1) We can offer 365-day audit retention as a flat-fee option: $9,500/mo (covers up to 10TB). For marginal storage, we'll bill at $0.07/GB/mo.
2) HSM: we'll include an apples-to-apples TCO table in the quote. For the pilot (2 seats) we recommend a KMS usage model to avoid upfront commitment. For expansion, we will switch to the per-seat tiered pricing (discount kicks in at 6 seats).
3) Residency uplift will be structured as: $12k one-time setup per region + $2.5k/mo regional overhead. We will waive the setup if BrightHealth signs a 12-month reserved capacity add-on.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll send a PO-ready quote (line items + an alternate single-line Credit option) by EOD tomorrow.
- If the security team needs CloudTrust attestation, I'll introduce their sales security contact (cc'd).
- DocuSign link will be included in the quote for faster signature.

If that sounds good I will proceed; otherwise tell me which of the three items you want to prioritize.

Thanks again — looking forward to moving to PO.
